crossRefs.note: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to…
I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools…
“What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and…
“Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the…
For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning…
Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities…
I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings…
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but…
But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you children of Israel; for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there…
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so it was well, then. Wasn’t this to know me?” says Yahweh.
This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

translations.web: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
translations.bsb: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
translations.kjv: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
translations.asv: For I desire goodness, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt-offerings.
